consumer.effective_timeout_reason: PipelineMapping.start currently passes batch_size but omits batch_timeout_seconds, so EventHubAsyncConsumer uses its default 300 seconds. This inherited behavior was kept unchanged in this fixes scope.

small_smoke.purpose: Verify minimum accepted 4-event count and retained exclusive-start replay on real Azure transport, with separate empty target and checkpoint table.

large_proof.purpose: Verify 200k-event acknowledged ingestion, persisted checkpoint restart and 40-event retained source replay after the failure-propagation fixes.

fault_injection: Actual CLI failure exit status, pending acknowledgment and shutdown failures are covered by deterministic offline regression tests; these live runs cover normal ingestion/restart/drain and real retained source replay.
